modelRequired: Only original owner arbiter commits a return through one activation control; queue/reserve is revocable and never grants direct C jump; closing and commit are mutually exclusive; consuming a committed return leaves live activation eligible for a fresh legal Scheme return, while duplicate transport receipt/old generation cannot repeat delivery

Clear marker only under valid root/heap write permit after published and claimed view obligations, object borrowers and prior writer drain, with new object-borrow admission closed at logical closing; do not hold permit while waiting for external borrower; unknown clear is replayable only as same false store with known stopped writer, valid shape and exact root-backed identity; no unknown decrement replay

Close admission before guard pop, revoke uncommitted reservations without waiting for requester ACK, preserve already committed target until owner matching consumption; transfer backed roots/init/physical duty before Closed publication; external close request is not permission to destroy C activation; no owner/claim/GC reverse wait

One activation generation, two transport deliveries, one active published/scanning view; original owner, complete stable roots, native stop/layout and managed typed-allocation admission are premises; neither C weak memory nor arbitrary collector/continuation execution is simulated

18 conditional declarations: close/commit exclusion, pin release/query Step/Trace conservation, write/reclaim rejection and indistinguishable legacy debit outcomes; not all QNT actions or C source/GC simulation

Actual C race freedom and release/acquire/lock refinement for lookup+pin, activation reservation/return commit/closing control, backed handoff, phase-scoped marker clear, pin-ledger release and generation reuse; changing raw -- to atomic does not add per-operation identity or memory reclamation proof

Managed marker cohort uses typed allocation with raw initial still-refcount zero and canonical registered root pin before admission; root ledger owns one idempotent release receipt, never raw --; every raw refcount writer/reader and opaque access must reject or be migrated for that cohort; legacy initial-one bridge retains root/debt on unknown debit and cannot infer outcome from scalar count

Distinguish C activation right, object/root borrow, metadata reader and independent committed result custody; acquire metadata protection during registry lookup; managed discriminator/key remains lifetime-stable in captured marker after metadata removal, so managed missing identity rejects late return without stale pointer while legacy classification remains unchanged; drain all required pins before record/generation reuse, preserve captured continuation roots and already committed results; no root/credit refund from unknown legacy debit

Root descriptor/index and epoch view must cover pending marker and quarantine before GC setup; counter-zero managed markers enter still mark queue through explicit root trace; no marker write/root unregister during published-but-unclaimed or claimed view; physical collection follows actual root/heap reachability and completed phase, not pin receipt or C pop

Existing CFUN TRY, W_ALL/R_ALL, argument conversion releases and custom AT_END effects remain caller obligations; qualify every intervening native frame and cleanup origin, settle native temporaries or explicitly transfer permitted duties before propagation; foreign-library continuation escape unsupported without contract, not converted to Tcl success/error by fiat

Guard closes bounded writers, publishes exact stopped initialization duty to pre-backed service escrow and preserves already committed wrapper/result right; no replay, rollback, root retirement or ticket refund from exception/unknown response; unknown managed stop/layout refuses admission or fail-stops violated admitted premise, never waits in an owner/GC cycle or fabricates ordinary return

C memory/lifetime refinement for stable pre-setjmp record handle, canonical result read, activation close/return claim, off-stack root publication, deferred physical marker write/refcount, catcher restore before propagation and generation reuse; acquire/release or locks never make raw racing SCMOBJ reads safe

Root cells and error/result/destination descriptors outlive every escaped C frame; logical activation close precedes pop, actual marker clear/refcount decrement waits exclusive root/heap write permission; return handler validates authoritative activation state without changing processor-hook ordering; queued return requests cannot resurrect closed activations; nonzero RC scan/teardown closure still required

Preserve current continuation destination and logical GVM frame coordinate through inner guard and CFUN bridges; never restore abandoned entry fp or invoke winding/destructor callbacks during settlement; only matched ___call consumes target frame; internal UNWIND_C_STACK_TO_TRAMPOLINE trips remain consumed by its loop and never close invocation; original activation/OS thread/processor generation and nonlocal-jump ABI remain mandatory
